 Study Break Snacks
 Need a quick brain break from hitting the books?
 Swing by Pless Hall, where the NYU Steinhardt Office of Student Affairs will be sharing free study break snacks to recharge and connect with fellow students. Whether you're powering through papers or prepping for exams, we’ve got plenty of sweet and savory treats to keep your energy up. While supplies last!
 No Registration Necessary 
 Date 
 Thu, December 10 
 Time 
 3 pm - 5 pm ET 
 Location 
 First Floor Lounge, Pless Hall 
 Cost 
 Free 
 Contact Us 
 NYU provides reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities. Please submit your
 request for accommodations for events and services at least two weeks before the date of
 your accommodation need. Although we can't guarantee accommodation requests received less
 than two weeks before the event, you should still contact us and we will do our best to
 meet your accommodation need. Please email
 Office of Student Affairs or call 212.998.5065 for assistance.
